The Authentic Bún Chả

Charcoal-grilled pork, fragrant fish sauce and Vietnamese soul food — made fresh every day in the heart of Footscray.

Our Story

A little corner of Hà Nội in Footscray

Cô Đào means "Auntie Đào" — and that is exactly the welcome we set out to give. Every bowl is built on a family recipe carried from Vietnam: pork marinated overnight, grilled over open charcoal, and finished with herbs picked that morning.

Tucked inside Footscray Market, our room is small, bright and full of life. Sit a while, slow down, and let the smell of the grill do the talking.

The Signature

Bún Chả, done properly

Smoky grilled pork & pork belly, a warm bowl of fish sauce, rice vermicelli, fresh herbs and pickled vegetables — assembled to order.

To Drink

Cà phê sữa đá

Slow-dripped robusta over a layer of sweet condensed milk, poured long over ice. Strong, sweet and built for a Melbourne afternoon.

Alongside it: jasmine tea, fresh sugarcane, salted-plum soda and seasonal Vietnamese coolers.
